title: Classify sharp rank-seven E8 support and fixed-frame equality
body:
## Summary

```text
binary label rank <= 7
  affine dimension <= 6
  signed character sum gives support <= 36
  equality: one extremal coset per nondegenerate perpendicular two-plane
  full E8: 5,440 equality spaces
  fixed P112: 448 avoid the deleted frame
```

Adds an analytic upper bound and complete equality criterion, with an exact fixed-frame classification and a literal attaining support. Extends PR3269's rank-five/six method; the new contribution is equality geometry, with no claim that capacity 36 was numerically unknown. Canonical geometry and the PR3154/3161/3162 E8/P112 lineage retain credit.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3269 stops at binary ranks five/six; the rank-seven frame-survival classification is absent from that package.
- After: polar-plane and independently reconstructed ordinary-dot RREF implementations agree on all 43,180 affine six-spaces and every maximizing support digest. The fixed P112 still attains 36.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized source/semantic controls, Ruff, exact committed-byte checks and all three direct scripts in the committed read-only Git-free CPython 3.13.16 export pass. The designated peer receipt and exact scientific/source hashes are retained in the package.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -I -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-rank7-capacity`.

No shortening, actual caller, scalar decoder floor, native program, consumer, supplier or kappa claim. Selected cold replay, Lean/Docker and human/proof-kernel review are unrun. Open next questions identify the missing caller binding before applying equality rigidity.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

One opt-in research package; frozen inputs and selected science are unchanged.
